question_text:
A large artificial ice cream for a shop front display is to be made with a hemisphere on top of an inverted cone.
The total height of the structure is $7\text{ m}$, and the cone is $4\text{ m}$ high.

subparts.stem: Show that the radius of the cone is $3\text{ m}$.
Calculate the total volume of the ice cream.
Find the slant height of the cone.
Find the total surface area of the ice cream.
The ice cream is to be made from a lightweight polymer, weighing $1.23\text{ kg per m}^2$. Calculate the total weight of the ice cream.
